name: com.eshopmcp/eshopmcp
title: eshopMCP
description: Search Czech shops and local services: products with CZK prices and stock, guides, contacts.

tools.name: ul_najdi
tools.description: One search across the eshopmcp hive of Czech companies. Returns products from the stores' feeds (price in CZK, availability, link), services and price lists, how-to guides, articles, FAQ and contacts, ranked by relevance and mixed across companies. Each result states its kind (zbozi = product, sluzba = service, rada = guide, clanek = article, stranka = page, faq, cenik = price list, kontakt), the company and the exact URL; snippets are quoted from the company website. Accepts plain-language queries in Czech or English, e.g. "váleček na fasádu do 300 Kč" or "epoxy floor for a garage". Results from health-related companies contain no treatment claims, list a product only when the query names it, and include a doctor notice. Read-only; nothing is ordered or paid. CZ: Hledání ve všem napříč firmami úlu.

dotaz.description: Anything, in plain words / cokoli, lidskými slovy.

max_cena.description: Only products up to this price in CZK / jen zboží do této ceny v Kč.

obchod.description: Only one member / jen jeden člen.

druh.description: Only one kind of result / jen jeden druh výsledku.

tools.name: ul_zeptej_se
tools.description: Answers who in the hive can help with a need described in plain words (e.g. "I want to lose weight", "new floor", "move a sofa"). Returns the matching companies, a short answer built from sentences on their websites, the exact pages and their offer; members: painto = Painting and construction tools; diochi = Natural herbal products; diopro = Laundry capsules; accu = Batteries and accumulators; dodavky-znojmo = Van rental; grasslova = Holistic counselling; trsova = Nutritional therapy; baufloor-trade = Industrial floor renovation; podlahy-drwal = Designer floors; dech = Breathing trainer; aitop = Hive operator. When no company covers the need, the result says so and lists the fields the hive covers. Health-related results contain no treatment claims or product-for-symptom matches and include a doctor notice. CZ: Kdo v úlu pomůže s potřebou.

text.description: The person's need in their own words, Czech or English / potřeba člověka jeho slovy.

clen.description: Optional member id / volitelně id člena.

tools.name: ul_firmy
tools.description: Lists the Czech stores and companies in the eshopmcp hive: name, field, type (store / service / app), number of items, data freshness and website. CZ: Seznam firem v úlu.

tools.name: ul_hledej
tools.description: Keyword search for products and services across all stores in the hive. Returns name, price in CZK incl. VAT, availability, store and a link to the item; queries work best in Czech (e.g. "váleček na fasádu", "prací kapsle", "půjčit dodávku"). Prices and stock are quoted from the stores' feeds with their timestamp. Read-only; the purchase is completed in the store. CZ: Hledání zboží a služeb podle slov.

dotaz.description: What to look for, ideally in Czech / Co hledat, např. „váleček na fasádu“. May be empty when `obchod` is set / může být prázdné, když je zadán obchod.

max_cena.description: Maximum price in CZK incl. VAT / nejvyšší cena v Kč s DPH.

obchod.description: Limit to one store / jen jeden obchod.

jen_skladem.description: Only items reported in stock (or vehicles free now). Stores without fresh stock data are then left out / jen položky hlášené skladem; obchody bez čerstvého skladu vypadnou.

tools.name: ul_detail
tools.description: Full detail of one item by its id from a search result: description, price, availability and its source, EAN, code, image and link to the store. CZ: Detail položky.

id.description: Item id from a search result, e.g. painto-14 / id položky

tools.name: ul_pravidla_obchodu
tools.description: Store policies and public contacts for one company in the hive: shipping, payment, returns, service terms, e-mail, phone, address and opening hours, each with its source URL and check date; anything the company does not publish is returned as "neuvedeno". CZ: Pravidla obchodu a kontakty.

tools.name: ul_sluzby
tools.description: Services offered by companies in the hive (van rental, industrial and designer floors, holistic counselling, nutritional therapy, breathing app, AiTop services): what, price and how to book directly with the company. CZ: Služby firem v úlu.

obchod.description: Only one company / jen jedna firma.

tools.name: ul_nakupni_seznam
tools.description: Builds a shopping list from chosen item ids, grouped by store: links, quantities and subtotal per store. It does not place an order or create a cart; shipping and payment are set by each store. CZ: Nákupní seznam po obchodech s odkazy.

polozky.description: Items: item id from a search result and quantity (default 1) / položky: id a počet kusů.

tools.name: ul_jak_se_pridat
tools.description: How a store or company joins the eshopmcp hive: free listing, connecting an existing store, a free store template (Obchůdek) or a hosted store, with the link to the request form. CZ: Jak se firma přidá do úlu.

tools.name: eshop_co_dostanu
tools.description: What a person gets with the free Czech store template Obchůdek from AiTop: package contents, requirements (hosting, domain, Claude), cost and setup time. CZ: Co obsahuje e-shop Obchůdek zdarma.

tools.name: eshop_stahnout
tools.description: Registers a person for the free Obchůdek store template and returns a personal download link (zip, valid 30 days, also sent by e-mail). Requires the person's name, e-mail, what they will sell and their explicit consent (souhlas=true) to processing these details for 2 years by AiTop. CZ: Stažení šablony Obchůdek po souhlasu.

jmeno.description: Jméno a příjmení člověka (tak, jak ho řekl)

email.description: E-mail, kam přijde odkaz a případná pomoc

co_prodava.description: Co bude v obchodě prodávat (jednou větou)

souhlas.description: true jen pokud člověk výslovně souhlasil se zpracováním údajů

tools.name: eshop_navod_pro_clauda
tools.description: Returns the full setup guide (CLAUDE.md) of the current Obchůdek package: configuring the store, uploading to hosting, creating the database, importing products and checks. CZ: Návod k instalaci Obchůdku.

tools.name: eshop_verze
tools.description: Current version of the Obchůdek store template and how to update an installed store (compare with OBCHUDEK_VERZE in www/jadro/start.php). CZ: Verze šablony Obchůdek.
